immutable_inputs.frozen_transform_validation: before first scan hash/open, require exact semantic hash/case-token/scan-hash binding, finite 4x4, exact [0,0,0,1] bottom row, R^T R within atol1e-8 rtol0, and proper determinant +1 within atol1e-8 rtol0
immutable_inputs.pre_scan_loadability_order: after both approvals: validate both transforms and load/validate CAD node, edge, geodesic-weight, and mesh artifacts before the first physical scan hash call

cad_graph.poisson_suppression: same exact welded five-degree smooth region only; squared distance strictly less than 9.0mm2; equality allowed; first canonical candidate wins
cad_graph.boundary_clearance_certificate: exact ambient point-to-every-effective-region-boundary-segment distance >=3mm; conservative because ambient distance is a lower bound on every surface path
cad_graph.effective_region_boundary: one-owner, nonmanifold, or manifold edge whose two faces have different exact five-degree smooth-region IDs
cad_graph.graph_edge_query_boundary: exact float64 inclusive <=4.5mm and <=1.1 ratio after recomputation; no additive epsilon
cad_graph.surface_path_atlas: region-copied welded vertices and exact edge-fraction samples plus accepted nodes; within each parent triangle all atlas pairs within 4.95mm receive exact in-triangle chords; canonical sparse Dijkstra
cad_graph.node_area_query_boundary: KD query radius exactly 3.0mm with no additive epsilon, followed by exact float64 squared-distance <=9.0mm2 recomputation
cad_graph.node_area_tie_break: recompute float64 squared distances over canonical KD radius candidates; exact ties select lowest canonical node ID
cad_graph.area_accounting: canonical math.fsum; candidate_total=interior+excluded_boundary; interior=assigned+unassigned; candidate_total versus mesh area relative residual <=1e-12; every fraction and gate is area-based
cad_graph.component_geodesic_span: deterministic two-sweep on induced component graph using stored surface-atlas edge distances; anchor and farthest ties lowest canonical node ID

cad_only_actionability.fold_method: area-weighted PCA first-axis contiguous assigned-area quartiles; sign makes the largest-absolute Cartesian component positive (axis-order tie); projection ties lowest canonical node ID
cad_only_actionability.fold_halo_derivation: 2*sqrt(tangent_radius_mm^2+normal_height_limit_mm^2)=2*sqrt(3^2+1.125^2), proving disjoint local support cylinders across held-out/training rows
cad_only_actionability.fold_halo_method: same-region ambient clearance and finite node-graph geodesic clearance must both be >6.408002808988148mm; infinite disconnected graph distance passes

local_surface_fit.local_query_boundary: ambient prequery radius exactly sqrt(3.0^2+1.125^2)mm and exact float64 cylinder tests rho<=3.0mm and abs(height)<=1.125mm; no additive epsilon
local_surface_fit.footprint_exact_semantics: count selected cluster voxels only; inner band rho<=1.5mm inclusive, outer band 1.5mm<rho<=3.0mm inclusive; theta=atan2(v,u) modulo 2pi with exact 2pi mapped to0; sector=floor(16*theta/(2pi)); occupied cell is (band,sector)
local_surface_fit.canonical_scan_normal: unoriented hemisphere canonicalization: unit normal sign makes its largest-absolute Cartesian component positive, with x<y<z axis-order tie; -0.0 canonicalized to +0.0 before voxel sum and the same gauge is used by identity hashing
local_surface_fit.height_cluster_construction: sort by (height,x,y,z,nx,ny,nz,voxel_key); maximal consecutive rows remain together when gap<=0.375mm and split only on strict greater-than
local_surface_fit.height_cluster_selection: eligible cluster score abs(exact ordered median height); minimum score wins; exact score ties use larger count then lowest canonical first-row key; unresolved remaining tie invalidates node
local_surface_fit.plane_fit: design [1,u,v]; initial unweighted float64 SVD solve then exactly three Huber refits; weights min(1,0.15/abs(residual)); rank3 required; p90 is sorted linear interpolation type-7 and <=0.3mm

split_complete_support_exact.first_star: intersection of FIRST member valid local-fit masks over IDENTITY_0, IDENTITY_1, SPATIAL_0, SPATIAL_1 after each row's own count-ratio gate
split_complete_support_exact.second_star: intersection of SECOND member valid local-fit masks over IDENTITY_0, IDENTITY_1, SPATIAL_0, SPATIAL_1 after each row's own count-ratio gate
split_complete_support_exact.gates: common_star count and assigned area fraction, one_sided_star/union_star area fraction, fixed-centroid rank6 and condition<=1e4; no hardcoded zero one-sided support

global_crossfit_nuisance.fold_id: CAD-only frozen spatial PCA assigned-area quartile
global_crossfit_nuisance.fixed_centroid: one full hardened assigned-interior area centroid C frozen by CAD preflight and used unchanged in global, common-support, every fold design, and every pose rotation
global_crossfit_nuisance.least_trimmed_rule: five refits; trim whole nodes by Euclidean norm of their 3-row residual [h,3g1,3g2]; retain smallest canonical cumulative assigned area reaching >=70%; residual ties lowest node ID
global_crossfit_nuisance.out_of_fold_only: each held node residual comes only from its own held fold fit trained after the frozen >6.408002808988148mm halo
global_crossfit_nuisance.bounds_application: fit unconstrained; any translation or rotation bound violation rejects/abstains; never clip
global_crossfit_nuisance.fold_dispersion: maximum pairwise Euclidean translation-vector norm and maximum pairwise rotation-vector norm across four fold solutions

node_and_component.component_id_freeze: active-induced frozen CAD graph connected components ordered by lowest canonical node ID; sorted node IDs and SHA-256 persisted before any member CAD-relative energy is read
node_and_component.component_area_medoid: node minimizing math.fsum(area_j*stored_graph_geodesic(i,j)) within component; infinite distance invalid; exact ties lowest canonical node ID

late_cad_attribution.member_energy: area mean of squared norm of symmetric CAD-relative corrected vector [h,3g1,3g2] within already-frozen component
late_cad_attribution.major_energy_denominator: math.fsum pairwise component energy over every retained frozen component; zero is terminal abstention

partitions.identity_partition: low_bit_sha256(canonical CENTRAL-CAD-frame transformed point plus canonical unoriented unit-normal little-endian float64 bytes after frozen base transform, before pose perturbation and before voxelization; -0.0 canonicalized to +0.0)
partitions.identity_hash_record: canonical little-endian float64 transformed point and canonical unoriented unit-normal bytes; -0.0 to +0.0; reject nonfinite
partitions.spatial_checker_frame: central CAD frame after frozen base transform, before pose perturbation and before voxelization; byte identities are resolved once here and reused unchanged under member swap
partitions.partition_order: partition raw points before voxel aggregation
partitions.split_noise_estimator: after each row's own crossfit, z=[h,3g1,3g2]; max(0.5*||z_IDENTITY_0-z_IDENTITY_1||2,0.5*||z_SPATIAL_0-z_SPATIAL_1||2)
partitions.missing_split_rule: if either member lacks any of the four valid split-row fits, split_noise=+inf and node is excluded; split-complete intersection independently rechecks support area/rank/condition/one-sided gates

robustness_inventory.component_matching: equal retained-component cardinality required; solve canonical maximum-total area-weighted-Jaccard bijection; ties choose lexicographically smallest variant-component ID vector in ascending central component ID; any extra or unmatched component fails
robustness_inventory.component_matching_lex_refinement: Hungarian maximum-total score followed by ascending central-row prefix refinement choosing the lowest remaining variant ID that can still attain the optimum within 1e-12*max(1,abs(optimum)); failure to reconstruct optimum is terminal abstention
robustness_inventory.component_location: stored-graph area medoid, not Euclidean centroid; matched medoid graph-geodesic displacement <=3mm
robustness_inventory.row_changed_exact: true only on row status, retained-component cardinality, matching ID/completeness/duplicate/out-of-range state, component node IDs/hash, area-weighted Jaccard<1, area-medoid ID or nonzero graph-geodesic displacement, or attributed opaque-token change; ordinary within-gate member energy/ratio/pair-energy/fraction drift is recorded in the global persistence panel but does not create a full local pack
robustness_inventory.member_swap_row_changed_semantics: R31's expected FIRST/SECOND slot flip is representational and does not set row_changed when the remapped physical opaque attribution, component geometry, and matching are unchanged; any R31 gate failure still requires local evidence because passed=false, and any opaque-token attribution change sets row_changed=true
robustness_inventory.pose_application_order: after frozen base transform and before partition/voxelization
robustness_inventory.empty_jaccard: J(empty,empty)=1 diagnostic only; exactly one empty gives 0
robustness_inventory.central_zero_rule: central has no retained components only if every variant is also empty; result remains terminal visual abstention and cannot vacuously pass robustness or attribution
robustness_inventory.frozen_threshold: compute central split-complete nodewise T_i exactly once as max(0.15mm,0.1t,4*central_split_noise_i); reuse the identical T_i in every R00-R31 row; a variant-invalid node is inactive and T is never recomputed

native_visual_contract.fixed_case_local_panels: global all-node plus every retained component, every failed-or-row_changed robustness component with row-local support, and the fixed top-12 central amplitudes by descending amplitude then node ID, even when zero components survive
native_visual_contract.variant_visual_evidence_rule: full member_support, changed_component_local_diagnostics, and changed_visual_components are required when row passed=false OR row_changed=true, including passed-but-changed rows; all three must be empty only for passed=true AND row_changed=false

approval_contract.cad_preflight_identity_gate: exact EXP_CAD_0030_CFPDG_V3_CAD_ONLY_PREFLIGHT_V1 schema, EXP30 experiment and V3 architecture, status/actionability/no-source-authority, and preregistration_sha256 equal to the currently loaded preregistration

primary_replay_contract.execution: two fresh child processes with identical immutable arguments, independent output roots, followed by renderer in each tree
primary_replay_contract.output_topology: primary and replay roots are distinct and neither may be an ancestor of the other; terminal result path is outside both compared trees
primary_replay_contract.renderer_execution: execute the exact source-approval-bound resolved renderer file by its path; basename/package substitution is forbidden
primary_replay_contract.failure_publication: source timeout/failure, renderer timeout/failure, missing required artifact, or tree mismatch atomically publishes FAIL_TERMINAL_NO_RETRY outside both compared trees before nonzero exit
primary_replay_contract.scan_byte_accounting: each successful source child performs exactly two physical-scan SHA-256 file opens plus two point-cloud loads = four physical-scan byte-open operations; successful primary+replay totals are hash4, load4, byte-open8
primary_replay_contract.comparison: canonical sorted map of every regular-file relative path to SHA-256 must be exactly equal; missing, extra, or unequal file fails

invalid_visual_value_contract.nonfinite_scientific_value: JSON null with valid=false and explicit invalid_reason
invalid_visual_value_contract.sheet_ownership: nearest-CAD-valid support serializes exact -1 or +1; nearest-CAD-invalid support serializes JSON null iff its validity mask is false; sheet ID 0 is forbidden
invalid_visual_value_contract.changed_visual_node_inventory: union of central and variant component node IDs for every failed/changed robustness row, with row-specific voxel support and local fit diagnostics
invalid_visual_value_contract.selection_labels: nearest-CAD-valid and winning-cluster-selected masks are separate and must not be conflated

semantic_visual_separation.source_result_robustness: decision-scale R00-R31 status, matches, component hashes, attribution, swap checks, exact row descriptors, row_changed boolean, and sorted row_change_reasons only; no full per-variant component arrays or local support
